name: memory
description: Remembers your project across chats: characters, style decisions, naming rules, asset lists, and how they relate. Runs the official Model Context Protocol memory server locally; the knowledge graph is a file in the plugin's own data folder, kept across updates. No account, no cloud.

interface.tagline: Remembers your project: characters, style decisions, naming, across chats.
prompts: Remember that our hero is Kael: a desert scout, cel-shaded, teal and sand palette, and every asset of his is named KAEL_<part>.
